The Founder

Giorgio Fratò

At 16, I was overweight and lost. No trainer, no money, no plan. Just a decision to change. In two years I transformed my body. But the real discovery was different: the change starts in the mind. The body follows.


I got certified at 19 and started working for 5 euros an hour. By 21, I opened Luxury Gym — a private, reservation-only fitness studio limited to 100 members. It was full within a year. Two years later, I opened the second one.


Today, at 26: two exclusive studios in Italy, 200 active members, 34 private coaching clients, 500+ people trained in 7 years. 15 hours a day, every day, for 7 years straight. For me, this is normal. For the market, it's unheard of.


Now I'm bringing The Italian Method to Miami. Not the American way — loud, fast, disposable. The Italian way: precise, silent, built to last.

The Ecosystem

Not a workout plan.
A complete transformation system.

Every program integrates five pillars into one seamless experience. No fragmented services. No guesswork. One method, one guide, one result.

01

Assessment & Diagnosis

Deep one-on-one consultation. Body composition analysis. Professional osteopathic evaluation. We find the real problem before writing a single exercise.

02

Personalized Programming

100% custom training plan. Postural correction integrated into every session. Scientific progression documented with photos and check-ins every 8 weeks.

03

Clinical Nutrition

Personalized nutrition plan. Practical food education — not punishment diets. Periodic follow-ups and adjustments based on real data.

04

Coaching & Mindset

The pillar that makes everything else work. Motivational sessions, neuroscience applied to change, stress management. This is where the real transformation happens.

05

Continuous Support

Direct WhatsApp access. Weekly check-ins. You're never alone in the process. The method works because the relationship doesn't end when the session does.

The Experience

What working with RE-FORMA
looks like

1

Complete Initial Assessment

A 90-minute deep dive into who you are, where you are, and where you want to go. Body, posture, habits, motivation. Nothing is skipped.

2

Custom Training Program

Built entirely around your goals, your body, your schedule. 3-4 sessions per week, each one guided personally by Giorgio. No assistants. No delegation.

3

Nutrition Strategy

A practical, sustainable nutrition plan designed for your lifestyle. Not a diet. A strategy. Adjusted as your body changes.

4

Mindset Coaching Sessions

The sessions that clients remember most. Deep motivational work that changes the way you think about yourself, your body, and your potential.

5

Documented Results

Progress photos, body composition data, performance metrics. Every 8 weeks, the results are undeniable — in black and white.
